percentile_algorithm.method: Linear interpolation between closest ranks (NIST/SciPy compliant: method='linear')
percentile_algorithm.formula: k = (N - 1) * p; index = floor(k); fraction = k - floor(k); Q(p) = (1 - fraction) * sorted[index] + fraction * sorted[index + 1]

raw_observation_schema.storage_format: JSON Lines (append-only, uncompressed during execution, hashed upon completion)
raw_observation_schema.outlier_policy: Preserve all observations. No deletion, no truncation, no winsorization. Raw data remains authoritative.
